findings.description: The docstring says the section is shown if at least one argument is documented, but the condition `all(arg.help is not None ...)` requires every argument to have help. Using `all` instead of `any` is the wrong quantifier.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments where only one has help text. `all` evaluates to False, so the whole 'Positional arguments' section is dropped and the documented argument disappears from the help output. Trigger 2: a command with no arguments makes `all([])` True, so an empty 'Positional arguments' section header is emitted with no entries.
